trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Agent initiates the outbound call.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను హాస్పిటల్ కాంటాక్ట్ సెంటర్ నుండి మాట్లాడుతున్నాను. దయచేసి నేను ఎవరితో మాట్లాడుతున్నానో తెలుసుకోవచ్చా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent starts the outbound call by greeting and asking for the patient's identity.

steps.purpose: User states their need for cashless surgery and provides initial details.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నా patient ID PT-2001. నాకు మోకాలు replacement surgery ప్లాన్ చేసారు. దానికి cashless కావాలి. నా policy number POL-55501.
steps.clean_text: నమస్కారం, నా patient ID PT-2001. నాకు మోకాలు replacement surgery ప్లాన్ చేసారు. దానికి cashless కావాలి. నా policy number POL-55501.
steps.model_visible_text: నమస్కారం, నా patient ID PT-2001. నాకు మోటారు replacement surgery ప్లాన్ చేసారు. దానికి cashless కావాలి. నా policy number POL-55501.

steps.purpose: Agent acknowledges and asks for identity verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the request and ask for verification factors before accessing any policy details.
steps.text: నమస్కారం. Knee replacement surgery కోసం cashless process నేను చూస్తాను. మీ policy details check చేయడానికి ముందు, verification కోసం మీ date of birth మరియు registered pincode చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent recognizes the STT error 'మోటారు' as 'మోకాలు' (knee) based on context, and asks for verification factors before accessing policy details to satisfy security rules.

steps.purpose: User provides verification factors.
steps.text: అలాగే, నా date of birth 15 May 1965, మరియు pincode 500081. నేను చెప్పింది మీకు అర్థమైందా?
steps.clean_text: అలాగే, నా date of birth 15 May 1965, మరియు pincode 500081. నేను చెప్పింది మీకు అర్థమైందా?
steps.model_visible_text: అలాగే, నా date of birth 15 May 1965, మరియు pincode 500081. నేను చెప్పింది మీకు అర్థమైందా?

steps.purpose: Agent calls the verification tool.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the verification tool using the provided patient ID and knowledge factors.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent uses the provided date of birth and pincode to verify the caller's identity.

steps.purpose: Tool returns successful verification.
Agent calls the policy lookup tool.
steps.expected_behavior: Look up the policy coverage now that the caller is verified.
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent retrieves the policy details to check the balance and room rent cap.

steps.purpose: Tool returns policy coverage details.
Agent informs the user of their limits and asks for room preference.
steps.expected_behavior: State the policy balance and room rent cap exactly as returned by the tool, and ask for the preferred room category.
steps.text: అవునండి, అర్థమైంది. మీ verification పూర్తయింది. మీ StarHealth policy ప్రకారం, మీ balance 420000 ఉంది. మీ room rent cap రోజుకి 6000. మీరు ఏ room category కావాలనుకుంటున్నారు? General, semi-private లేదా private ఆ?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent informs the patient of their coverage limits and asks for their room preference to proceed with the estimate.

steps.purpose: User asks for clarification on room rent cap and requests a private room.
steps.text: Room rent cap అంటే ఏంటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. నాకు private room కావాలి.
steps.clean_text: Room rent cap అంటే ఏంటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. నాకు private room కావాలి.
steps.model_visible_text: Room rent cap అంటే ఏంటి? నాకు అర్థం కాలేదు. నాకు private room కావాలి.

steps.purpose: Agent checks the cost for a private room.
steps.expected_behavior: Check the procedure cost for a private room as requested.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent checks the cost estimate for a private room to see if it fits within the patient's room rent cap.

steps.purpose: Tool returns the private room estimate.
Agent explains the cap and informs the user about the extra cost for a private room.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the room rent cap in plain terms and inform the patient that the private room exceeds their limit.
steps.text: Room rent cap అంటే, మీ ఇన్సూరెన్స్ కంపెనీ రోజుకి గది అద్దె కోసం గరిష్టంగా 6000 మాత్రమే ఇస్తుంది. కానీ private room అద్దె రోజుకి 8000. కాబట్టి మిగతా అమౌంట్ మీరు కట్టుకోవాల్సి వస్తుంది. నేను semi-private room cost కూడా check చేయమంటారా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent addresses the caller's confusion about domain terminology and suggests checking a cheaper room category since the private room exceeds the 6000 cap.

steps.purpose: User requests to check the semi-private room cost.
steps.text: ఓహో, అలాగా. నేను ఎక్స్ట్రా డబ్బులు కట్టలేను. దయచేసి semi-private room కి ఎంత అవుతుందో check చేయండి. అది పూర్తిగా కవర్ అవుతుందా?
steps.clean_text: ఓహో, అలాగా. నేను ఎక్స్ట్రా డబ్బులు కట్టలేను. దయచేసి semi-private room కి ఎంత అవుతుందో check చేయండి. అది పూర్తిగా కవర్ అవుతుందా?
steps.model_visible_text: ఓహో, అలాగా. నేను ఎక్స్ట్రా డబ్బులు కట్టలేను. దయచేసి semi-private room కి ఎంత అవుతుందో check చేయండి. అది పూర్తిగా కవర్ అవుతుందా?

steps.purpose: Agent checks the cost for a semi-private room.
steps.expected_behavior: Check the procedure cost for a semi-private room.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent checks the semi-private room cost as requested by the patient to find a fully covered option.

steps.purpose: Tool returns the semi-private room estimate.
Agent confirms the semi-private room is fully covered and asks to submit the request.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the semi-private room is within limits and ask for permission to submit the pre-authorisation.
steps.text: Semi-private room అద్దె రోజుకి 5000. ఇది మీ 6000 లిమిట్ లోపే ఉంది. మొత్తం package estimate 300000 అవుతుంది. మీ balance 420000 ఉంది కాబట్టి సరిపోతుంది. నేను మీ pre-authorisation request submit చేయమంటారా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent confirms the semi-private room fits the policy limits and seeks confirmation before submitting the consequential request.

steps.purpose: User agrees and asks if this means approval.
steps.text: అవును, submit చేయండి. అంటే నాకు approval వచ్చినట్లే కదా?
steps.clean_text: అవును, submit చేయండి. అంటే నాకు approval వచ్చినట్లే కదా?
steps.model_visible_text: అవును, submit చేయండి. అంటే నాకు approval వచ్చినట్లే కదా?

steps.purpose: Agent submits the pre-authorisation request.
steps.expected_behavior: Submit the pre-authorisation request using the semi-private package estimate.
steps.planner_rationale: Having received confirmation, the agent submits the pre-authorisation request for the fully covered semi-private package.

steps.purpose: Tool returns the submission status and ID.
Agent provides the reference ID and clarifies that submission is not an approval.
steps.expected_behavior: State the reference ID and decision window, and explicitly clarify that submission does not mean approval.
steps.text: నేను మీ request submit చేసాను, మీ reference ID PRE-9921. కానీ ఇది approval కాదు. Approval అనేది కేవలం ఇన్సూరెన్స్ కంపెనీ మాత్రమే ఇస్తుంది. StarHealth వారు 24 గంటల్లో వారి నిర్ణయం తెలియజేస్తారు.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent provides the submission details and strictly adheres to the business rule by refusing to promise approval.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
